items.title: Trump says he’s asked Dana White to serve as press secretary
items.brief: President Donald Trump said Saturday he asked Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White to be his next press secretary.

items.title: US offers millions for information on Iran’s nuclear program despite Trump’s claims of obliteration
items.brief: The United States is offering a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran’s nuclear program, despite US President Donald Trump’s repeated claims to have obliterated Tehran’s capabilities.

items.title: Gunman who killed 6 in Kraków attack held far-right views, Polish minister says
items.brief: At least six people have been killed and 15 more wounded when a gunman opened fire from his car in the southern Polish city of Kraków on Saturday, according to authorities.

items.title: 1 killed, 22 injured after elderly driver suspected to be impaired strikes cyclists in North Carolina, officials say
items.brief: At least one person is dead and 22 others were injured when an elderly driver struck a group of cyclists in Wake County, North Carolina, shortly after 9:30 a.m.

items.title: A father who taught his daughter to love flying is mourning after her Learjet crashed in Florida
items.brief: Nathalia Gadelha Filgueiras was 12 when she started going up in planes while her father was at the controls, watching the ground fall away beneath them.

items.title: Supreme Court’s trend on church and state is a reminder conservatives have a steady grip on the nation’s laws
items.brief: The Supreme Court first agreed to hear the case that launched the justices’ current trajectory protecting the free exercise of religion in January 2016.
